locations.note: Getaway driver TK is framed for a kidnap-murder by Corrigan's crew in 1978 and, out of prison 28 years later, hunts them down across the city.
Ray's Autos, the garage TK comes back to between jobs, is where Corrigan reveals Ray sold TK out and then kills him.
TK drives through it in both eras, its lights and billboards changing between 1978 and 2006.
In 1978 TK can get onto the Twin Towers' plaza; by 2006 the site is walled off.
